scan_skill_security: scan a skill directory for security threats using regex-based static analysis and return a ScanResult with verdict
test_should_allow_install: test the should_allow_install function with a ScanResult to determine if a skill passes the trust-aware install policy
review_format_scan_report: review the format_scan_report function to produce a human-readable security scan report sorted by severity
scan_file_patterns: scan a single file against threat patterns for exfiltration, injection, destructive commands, persistence, and obfuscation
compute_content_hash: compute a SHA-256 hash of all files in a skill directory for integrity tracking and change detection
